_readme: Labelled example questions for the embedding-based relevance fallback (used only when no LLM verdict is available). Written by the M3 developer and deliberately disjoint from the evaluation/m3_settings_set.json no_plan items. The in_scope list also includes the seeds and dev (even index) paraphrases of evaluation/m3_paraphrase_set.json; its held-out (odd index) paraphrases are not included. The official queries in data/input.txt are added as in-scope examples at load time.
